SELECT uv_index AS "Value", to_char((observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM weather_observation WHERE uv_index IS NOT NULL ORDER BY uv_index DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT solar_energy_wh_m2 / 1000.0 AS "Value", to_char(observation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE solar_energy_wh_m2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY solar_energy_wh_m2 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT distance_miles AS "Value", to_char(COALESCE(last_strike_at_local::date, (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM lightning_observation WHERE distance_miles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance_miles ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT dewpoint_f AS "Value", to_char((observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM weather_observation WHERE dewpoint_f IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dewpoint_f DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT dewpoint_f AS "Value", to_char((observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date" FROM weather_observation WHERE dewpoint_f IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dewpoint_f ASC LIMIT 1

WITH days AS (
  SELECT observation_date, (rainfall_in > 0) AS wet
  FROM daily_weather_summary
  WHERE rainfall_in IS NOT NULL
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT observation_date, wet,
         observation_date - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wet ORDER BY observation_date))::int AS grp
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT wet, MIN(observation_date) AS start_date, MAX(observation_date) AS last_date, COUNT(*)::int AS day_count
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY wet, grp
),
record AS (
  SELECT start_date, last_date, day_count
  FROM streaks
  WHERE wet = false
  ORDER BY day_count DESC, start_date ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT day_count AS "Days",
       to_char(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Start",
       CASE WHEN last_date + 1 = CURRENT_DATE THEN '—'
            ELSE to_char(last_date + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS "End (exclusive)"
FROM record
